name: Get Started Clicked
description: User clicked a 'Get Started' CTA button — tracks which placement drove the signup intent (header, hero, or pricing card). Autocapture covers clicks but can't extract the business context (source, plan name) from data-attributes.

name: Book Demo Clicked
description: User clicked a 'Book a Demo' link from the hero or nav — indicates high-intent users interested in a guided walkthrough before signing up.

name: Demo Requested
description: User successfully submitted the Book a Demo form — the primary conversion event on the marketing site. Fires after the API call succeeds and the success state is shown. Properties: category (use case), company.

name: Demo Request Failed
description: The demo form submission failed (validation error or API error) — helps identify friction in the conversion flow. Properties: error_reason (validation | api_error), fields_with_errors.
